difficulty.reasoning: The minimal reproduction task implements the self-energy functional approach (SFA) for a two-orbital Hubbard model at zero temperature. The method requires setting up the reference Hamiltonian (a two-site cluster per orbital), computing the grand potential as a function of hybridization parameters, and finding stationary points. This is an established non-trivial many-body technique that demands careful implementation of the Luttinger-Ward functional and exact diagonalization of a small quantum system. The pipeline is simple (one script to sweep U and produce a CSV and a text file) with no external tooling or data acquisition.
